description: Canonical ID registry. Every concept, layer, role, operating model, jurisdiction, moral dimension, requirement, and control has one stable id, a human name, and a URL. IDs are namespaced: srf.layer.*, srf.opmodel.*, srf.role.*, srf.concept.*, srf.data.*, srf.jurisdiction.*, srf.moral.*, srf.vertical.*, srf.control.<vertical>.*, ext.framework.*, ext.requirement.*.

namespaces.srf.layer: One of the five architecture layers L1-L5
namespaces.srf.opmodel: One of the four operating models
namespaces.srf.role: One of the SRF personas or a declared sector specialization
namespaces.srf.data: A machine-readable data catalog resource under /data/
namespaces.srf.jurisdiction: A jurisdiction that issues a regulation or standard
namespaces.srf.vertical: An industry vertical that owns a control schema
namespaces.ext.requirement: A concrete requirement inside an external instrument
